This idea is a long term one since it would probably require API work, but it could potentially provide Voat with extra exposure and content at the same time. Since news sites often outsource their comments sections to a third-party (disqus is commonly used), Voat could create a comments section module to provide this functionality to whatever news sites want to use it.

At first the module would start as a simple "Share this story on Voat" button. Once someone has clicked the button and shared the story on Voat, the module expands to a scroll-able box that includes the comments section for whatever subverse the story was shared to. Signed in users could comment directly in this space, or create a Voat account to join in the conversation.

The module would create multiple embedded tabs as the story is shared to more subs (for example, a story might be shared in /v/gaming, so you'd see that conversation in the module. If someone shares the story to /v/PCGaming, that would show up as a small tab next to /v/gaming's tab, and you can switch between the different conversations as they begin.

It's a rough idea, but could give Voat some extra exposure, and provide Voat-friendly news sites a way to outsource their comments section to a community that already exists.
